text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho was not originally set as 
a goal. However, on the path toward her 
dream of becoming a legendary Umamusume, I 
recommended she enter to gauge her current 
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand somehow manages to pull 
herself together. Meanwhile, her rivals 
are already sending sparks flying, sizing 
each other up before the race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Putting their respective destinies on the 
line, the battle for the Classic Triple 
Crown is sparked—!
